note: v4 Phase 2A look check (2026-11-05, Nusrat): renders every candidate look in fixed Humanoid poses with the pan-tilt camera settings, so the existing Python models can be run on the images before any gesture clip is made. A development check, not an evaluation: no threshold is set or changed from it. Read by Tools > Warehouse v4 > Look Check (Editor only); nothing in the v3 or v4 study scenes reads it.

why.distances_m: 2.0 m is the v3 approach distance (the robot stops 2.0 m from the person and asks); 3.0 m is the far end of the asking range.
why.vertical_fovs_deg: 60 deg is the pan-tilt default (robot_unity_v4.json); 30 deg is a zoom inside configs/v4/control.json zoom fov_min_deg..fov_max_deg (15..60).
why.camera: Width, height, height above the floor, near and far planes and the level tilt come from paths.robot_unity_config -> pan_tilt_camera through PanTiltCamera.ApplyCameraSettings, the code the robot uses; only vertical_fov_deg is replaced by each value above.
why.scene: Neutral grey floor and backdrop and one directional light, so the looks are compared under the same light; the warehouse background is not part of this check.
why.magenta_tolerance: A pixel counts as error-shader magenta when R and B are >= 255 - tolerance and G <= tolerance (8-bit).

poses_note: Directions are the robot's, as in v3 GestureWorker: the worker faces the camera, so point_left (robot's left) raises the worker's RIGHT arm level to the worker's right, point_right the LEFT arm mirrored, point_up the right arm straight up. POINT hands: index extended along the arm, other fingers curled. wait: right upper arm out to the side, forearm vertical, hand beside the head, index up, other fingers curled, palm toward the camera. stop: right arm toward the camera, hand bent up, palm toward the camera, all fingers extended and spread. neutral: both arms hanging, fingers relaxed.

hand.why: fist_curl_deg, fist_thumb_curl_deg and rest_outward are v3 GestureWorker's values (fingerCurlDeg, thumbCurlDeg, restOutward). relaxed and spread values are pose design (a loosely open hand hanging; fingers fanned by stop_spread_deg per finger away from the middle finger), chosen before any model was run.

looks_note: VRoid looks: copy each .vrm into Assets/ThirdParty/VRoid/ (git-ignored) and add one entry like vrm_seed_san (kind prefab, asset = the .vrm path, family vrm, role candidate). Sunbox variants: the pack's preset .txt files are not used (the free pack has no preset loader, and the presets name items and hair styles of the paid pack); each variant is the free pack's own items named here. A look whose asset is not installed is reported as not_installed, never skipped silently.
